about: The users, groups and OAuth clients of the identity service the test harness runs (the OCI gateway's identity
role) when OAuth:Mode is Managed. Essbase, created in Identity Cloud mode, looks every user up here; the
administrator comes from the harness's connection settings and is added by the gateway.
poweruser and user are the accounts of the harness's PowerUser and User connections (appsettings.json), which
an Identity Cloud server cannot create itself. Each "essbase" entry is applied to Essbase by the gateway on
every start and every two minutes after: "role" is the service role, "applications" the roles per application;
an application that does not exist yet is skipped until it does.
alice (service administrator) and bob (user, Sample only) are the OAuth tests' users; carol holds no role.
